name: astroagent
description: Agent skills to process astrophotography campaigns from a Nebulis library to a finished image in PixInsight, through the pixinsight-connector MCP server: sub review, calibration plan, WBPP stacking, dual-band HOO/SHO or broadband processing, export, processing log, and project documentation: rig.json from FITS headers, PixInsight project description, documentation page, session report, process icons, AstroBin fields.
